alexcrichton opened PR #15165 from alexcrichton:bindgen-allow-sync-exports-async-imports to bytecodealliance:main:

The validation added in #15000 was unfortunately a bit too eager in the classification of sync/async and disallowed valid configurations. An example is in spinframework/spin#3773 there are async imports and sync exports, but the exports are all bindgen'd with async. This commit reverts the validation/error from #15000 and adds a small test to ensure that this keeps working in the future.
